content: Yohanis man ulutade ri nin honowok nair
Lere Yesus minle leke Nazaret makun, Yohanis ma nodi oir ulutada ri mai Yudea loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan laa ri lolo noho mamun ma napro'uk man ai lolo onne. Ai na'aheni,
“Herre minim morimori ma ka namloleni, la derne makani Makromod Lalap, ono lere Makromod nodi molollo ri mormori wakuraniyedi me'e.”
Nonolu nabi Yesaya wekel Yohanis eni na'aheni,

content.text: “Ri ida aile lolo noho mamun ma napro'uk wakaukau na'aheni,
‘Ma'ahari kalla, la ma'anehe, leke Makromod lole.’ ”

content: Yohanis eni nin nainair rodi unta wulu hi'ie, nin kali ehe rodi ha mormori ulikne hi'ie, la nina nana'an nonomun poreke noro wani oir.
Ri nammori rano Yerusalem, Yudea ne'en raramne na'akeme, noro leke-leke man minle oir wauwau Yordan wali-wali maiwuku, derne Yohanis nin loloi kakaru eni.
Hi meririi werre akin kukunohi rira dohohale nanumene Yohanis norhe laa oir Yordan raram leke ulutade.

Enimaa lere an do'on ri Parisi noro ri Saduki nammori mai leke ulutade ne, ai ne'el hi na'ahenia, “Heih, mi eniyenihe ailanna maisa haimoke! Yon makoto mim mai ulutade leke lo'o mahinuriyedi nano hunukum lere man mamai eni.
Maa lam hi'i ha man wa'an leke ri nauroin mim herredi minima morimori ma ka namloleni, la derne makani Makromod Lalap me'e.
Yon makoto mi mamwali Abraham upun anan de kam lernala hunukum. Makromod Lalap peni nodi molollo hi'i waku eniyenihe herre mi namwali Abraham upun anan.
Makromod Lalap Nin hunukum na'akeki rakanedi me'e. Lere eni Ai na'akenedi Nin he'i aile au onno me'e. Inhawa au'ono ma kan woi wawa'an, An keri, sopol laedi aiye raram.

Yo odi oir ulutada mi leke namwali tanada mim herredi minima morimori ma ka namloleni, maa yo oluwedi Ri ida man ulutada mi nodi Roh Kudus noro aiye. Ai nodi molollo narehi ya'u, penia ainu'u molollo kaale yo ohu Nina pakpak ei.
Ai nodi kokopo ka'i na'amou Nina gandum, loiwuku ihin dakar raram, la osorne sopol laedi aiye man mori mamani raram.”
Lere onneni Yesus namhara noho Galilea mai oir wauwau Yordan leke Yohanis ulutade,
maa Yohanis na'okulale na'aheni, “Wa'an rehi Pape ulutada ya'u. Yon Papa napanak ya'u ulutade.”
Maa Yesus na'aheni, “Wa'an rehi ors eni ulutade Ya'u leke ik ka'akuku ka'anokor Makromod Lalap Nin honorok panaeku na'akemeni.” Enine ai ne'e, de noro Yesus laa oir raram leke ulutade.
Yesus namhara oir wauwau eni ne, namlilinnohi a'am nahinari, An po'on Makromod Lalap Nin Roh naise merpati ida kopur namlololo Ai wawan.
Enla lirida nano a'am raram na'aheni, “E'eni Ya An'u, Ya amre'e amharu. An hi'i Ya akin nahuwa'an rehi.”
